import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    # Load the source data
    df = inputs["meter_reads"].copy()
    
    # Sort by meter_id ASC, read_ts ASC, read_seq ASC
    df = df.sort_values(
        by=["meter_id", "read_ts", "read_seq"],
        ascending=[True, True, True],
        na_position="last"
    )
    
    # Dedup: keep LAST row per meter_id (which is the latest after sorting)
    # This is equivalent to keeping the last occurrence of each meter_id
    df = df.drop_duplicates(subset=["meter_id"], keep="last")
    
    # Aggregate: group by zone and compute SUM(kwh) and COUNT(*)
    # Note: NULL zone values are treated as a real group
    agg_result = df.groupby("zone", as_index=False, dropna=False).agg({
        "kwh": "sum",
        "meter_id": "count"
    })
    
    # Rename columns to match output schema
    agg_result = agg_result.rename(columns={
        "kwh": "total_kwh",
        "meter_id": "meter_count"
    })
    
    # Reorder columns to match expected output: zone, total_kwh, meter_count
    agg_result = agg_result[["zone", "total_kwh", "meter_count"]]
    
    return {"zone_totals": agg_result}
